image_description: A close-up view of a suit of historical armor, specifically focusing on the torso. The central element is a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) with a raised center ridge and embossed decorative patterns. It is worn over a blue chainmail hauberk. The armor includes articulated faulds (waist plates) and tassets (thigh guards). The shoulders feature pauldrons with brass or gold-colored trim. To the right, a portion of a sword hilt is visible.
